jsonld.name: La Cantina Food Truck
jsonld.description: Venezuelan food truck in Clearwater, FL serving empanadas, cachapas and pastichos made fresh to order, with catering available for private events.

parrafo.es: La Cantina Food Truck sirve comida venezolana en 2380 NE Coachman Rd, Clearwater. Empanadas, cachapas, pasticho venezolano y burgers, preparados al momento de pedirlos. También arman el food truck o el menú para catering en eventos privados.
parrafo.en: La Cantina Food Truck serves Venezuelan food at 2380 NE Coachman Rd, Clearwater. Empanadas, cachapas, Venezuelan pasticho and burgers, all made fresh when you order. They also bring the truck or put together a menu for catering at private events.

hero.imagen_alt: La Cantina Food Truck lit up at dusk with its neon open sign, order window and outdoor seating in Clearwater, FL

parrafo_1.es: La Cantina Food Truck es un negocio familiar, identificado como Latino-owned en su ficha de Google, que sirve comida venezolana en Clearwater: empanadas, cachapas, pasticho venezolano y burgers, todo preparado fresco al momento de pedirlo.
parrafo_1.en: La Cantina Food Truck is a family business, listed as Latino-owned on Google, serving Venezuelan food in Clearwater: empanadas, cachapas, Venezuelan pasticho and burgers, everything made fresh the moment you order it.

parrafo_2.es: Las reseñas en Google repiten lo mismo: porciones grandes, sabor casero y un servicio tan amable que varios clientes cuentan que les regalaron un cafecito (guayoyo) mientras esperaban su pedido.
parrafo_2.en: Reviews on Google keep saying the same thing: big portions, homemade flavor and service so friendly that several customers mention getting a complimentary coffee (guayoyo) while they waited for their order.

h2_shine.es: de la parrilla a tu mesa
h2_shine.en: from the grill to your table

texto.es: Visítanos en 2380 NE Coachman Rd, Clearwater, o llama antes para pedir con tiempo.
texto.en: Visit us at 2380 NE Coachman Rd, Clearwater, or call ahead to place your order early.

texto.es: Empanadas, cachapas, pasticho venezolano y burgers, con varias opciones de relleno.
texto.en: Empanadas, cachapas, Venezuelan pasticho and burgers, with several filling options.

texto.es: Cada plato se cocina cuando lo pides, tal como cuentan los clientes en sus reseñas.
texto.en: Every dish is cooked when you order it, exactly as customers describe in their reviews.

titulo.en: Enjoy it here or to go

texto.es: Siéntate en las mesas del food truck o pide para llevar. También armamos catering para tu próximo evento.
texto.en: Sit at the truck's tables or take it all to go. We also set up catering for your next event.

nota.es: Los precios del menú están disponibles en el food truck. El catering para eventos se cotiza según el grupo y la cantidad de invitados.
nota.en: Menu prices are posted at the truck. Catering for events is quoted based on your group and guest count.

texto.es: Las reseñas de Google las mencionan una y otra vez: grandes, recién fritas y con relleno generoso.
texto.en: Google reviews mention them again and again: big, freshly fried and generously filled.

texto.es: Tortitas de maíz dulce con queso, carne mechada o cerdo desmenuzado. El plato que más repiten los clientes.
texto.en: Sweet corn cakes with cheese, shredded beef or shredded pork. The dish repeat customers mention the most.

texto.es: Pasticho venezolano y otros platos tradicionales, además de burgers y papas fritas.
texto.en: Venezuelan pasticho and other traditional dishes, plus burgers and french fries.

texto.es: Llevamos el food truck o armamos el menú para tu próximo evento. Escríbenos para cotizar según invitados y ubicación.
texto.en: We bring the food truck or put together a menu for your next event. Reach out for a quote based on guests and location.

pie.es: ¿Tienes un evento en mente? Llama y lo cotizamos juntos.
pie.en: Have an event in mind? Call and we will quote it together.

subtitulo.en: 396 reviews on Google, rated 4.9 out of 5.

items.quote: This was a nice find it is right off the bike trail. Empanadas are very good, can't wait to try something else next time. Service also was amazing she gave me a complimentary coffee.
Amazing customer service! Great variety of Venezuelan food. It is a nice and friendly place! I highly recommend it!
Best Empanadas around Pinellas county! You need to try again and again!
So delicious! We keep coming back for the cachapas and everyone we bring always loves them. We've tried the one with shredded beef, shredded pork and the regular one. Always a hit!
